data.one_liner: A collection of tools for building command-line interfaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools and utilities for developing command-line interfaces in Dart, including an enhanced command runner and support for command-line completion.
use_when: You are building a custom command-line interface in Dart or Serverpod.
You need command-line completion support for your CLI application.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or web UI application.
strengths: Designed specifically for command-line interface development
weaknesses: Limited documentation in the provided README besides high-level overviews
